intent.summary: Consumes available free space along a parent layout axis without adding visible or semantic content.
useWhen: Sibling separation should flex with available space
avoidWhen: A fixed gap or alignment rule expresses the intent

semantics.sizing: grows from minimum toward available free space according to weight
semantics.ordering: occupies a layout position but not a semantic position

attributes.name: minimum
attributes.description: Smallest permitted extent on the parent main axis.

attributes.name: weight
attributes.description: Relative share of free space among sibling spacers.

constraints.message: Spacer minimum is non-negative and weight is positive.

accessibility.focusBehavior: not focusable and absent from accessibility tree

mappings.strategy: Capture minimum length and infer the parent main axis.
Represent as proportional free-space track rather than a visible element.
